# bm25-index

> Incremental BM25 index with add, update and remove, multilingual analysis with diacritic folding and CJK bigrams, and atomic JSON persistence without pickle Python package `trysac-bm25-index`, import name `bm25_index`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Testing](docs/TESTING.md): how to run and extend the tests
